method: Direct source reads and local synthetic MemSpine probes. No third-party code installed or executed. No new Claude agent used for this verification.

engine_checks.name: MemSpine
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: Window fact validation accepts a matching normalised span; edge validation checks cited indices without receiving source text. A synthetic unsupported assertion passes each gate.
Graph keys omit kind in plain mode. Dated keys add day/numerals, not a distinct occurrence ID. Function probes reproduce collisions.
Packing stops on an oversize candidate after selecting an item; the first oversize item is intentionally allowed. Existing tests encode that contract.
Resource ingest re-extracts and re-chunks the document, but skips writing unchanged chunks by path/content fingerprint. Whole-document rewrite is an overstatement.
A relevance-gated, per-subject profile card already has a token allowance. G-W30 must specify the remaining typed persistent-card work.

engine_checks.name: MemU
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: Commit plans first, resolves embeddings, then performs storage writes. This protects against embedding failure, not arbitrary mid-write storage failure.
Bridge advances the snapshot and pending session cursor after backend commit returns; cleanup happens later. This is staged progress, not proof of a globally atomic commit.
The inspected retrieval function embeds the query and gathers segment/file/resource hits without an extraction or answer-model call. Host-agent work is outside that function.

engine_checks.name: Mnemon
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: Record mutation holds a lock, validates revisions, fsyncs a temporary file and renames it. Full platform power-loss guarantees, including directory sync, were not established.

Consolidation attempts a reply twice, then optionally splits the batch. If both halves parse-fail, failures are counted and the original pending batch can still be advanced; a thrown exception restores the memory snapshot.

Consolidated facts append dated values and conflict flags under a lowercased key. References are range-filtered; the inspected function does not require every accepted item to have a nonempty reference list.

engine_checks.name: LightMem
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: The write returns before extraction when no segments or no buffer trigger exist. Durability of buffered input is separate from fact insertion.
Offline update changes memory text and sends the old vector to update; delete invokes the vector-store delete method.
Extraction exceptions return an empty cleaned_result and no usage; no retry is present in the inspected wrapper.
Pre-compression and topic segmentation both default to false in BaseMemoryConfigs.

engine_checks.name: Memori
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: Cloud augmentation is an HTTP request with configured attempts and backoff; background failures are logged. Hosted prompt and internal model-call count cannot be verified from this SDK.
The inspected local candidate ranking combines dense and lexical scores; this is not evidence of how the hosted service ranks.

engine_checks.name: Combined Graphiti + SimpleMem
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: The API appends graphiti/simplemem to stored_in after awaited calls without checking their return values. SimpleMem fan-out is assistant-only and errors are logged.
Extraction loops over max_retries; on final failure migration raises ExtractionError while live mode returns an empty list. The configured attempt count is not universally three.

engine_checks.name: Honcho
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: Deriver enqueue is scheduled as a FastAPI BackgroundTask, with separate immediate embedding scheduling. A response is not a synchronous guarantee that these tasks finished.
Representations carry the latest message timestamp and save into observer/observed collections. Empty observations are logged.

engine_checks.name: Cognee
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: Graph text assembly deduplicates nodes by node.id, then includes full text for each retained node. The inherited claim that every edge repeats a whole chunk is incorrect for this function.
Contradiction detection defaults off. Summary method defaults llm, with an alternative from_extraction mode.
Session caching and auto_feedback default true, with concurrent session search and a seven-day TTL. These settings alone do not reproduce the hosted benchmark token count.

engine_checks.name: MIRIX
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: Queue type defaults to memory; Kafka is an environment-selectable alternative. The default number of workers is one.
Selected memory updates run through gather(return_exceptions=True); after all finish, a failed result raises. Successful siblings are not rolled back by this function.

engine_checks.name: MemMachine
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: Episode, episodic-memory and semantic-memory work run concurrently; results are checked after gather. The code explicitly notes unresolved partial-write repair.
delete_history explicitly removes citation and ingested-history rows. This function does not explicitly delete feature rows; complete erasure requires tracing schema cascades and all callers.

engine_checks.name: Mem0 OSS
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: The inspected additive extraction path passes existing memories and recent messages into one LLM request. Provider failure raises; parsing failure becomes an empty extraction with messages saved.
Deleting a vector writes its previous text to the history store as DELETE with is_deleted=1. This is a retention mechanism, not complete text erasure.

engine_checks.name: MemOS
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: The inner fine-string extractor catches a generation exception and constructs a raw-text fallback memory. Therefore not every extraction error loses content.
A fine-transfer exception returns from the scheduler handler before deletion.

The handler can reach raw/working deletion after a zero-result branch; deletion also depends on the memory-version switch. This is a conditional path, not a runtime reproduction of every malformed reply.

engine_checks.name: Nemori
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: The episode generator catches ordinary exceptions and returns a raw-transcript fallback. Claude’s statement that an episode-generation exception simply propagates was incomplete.
The fallback retains source messages and marks fallback=true; it does not supply an embedding in this constructor.
The system marks buffered IDs processed after processing groups; semantic-generation failures are caught and logged. A retained episode and missing semantic facts are distinct outcomes.

engine_checks.name: EverMemOS / EverOS
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: Memorize awaits the user pipeline, and in agent mode gathers user and agent pipelines, before constructing the result. No boundary cells returns early.
Atomic facts are an offline strategy triggered by EpisodeExtracted; extraction consumes episode text and writes facts with episode parent IDs. This is not direct extraction from all raw turns.

engine_checks.name: Hindsight
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: The extraction wrapper recursively splits on output overflow, but returns empty facts when splitting cannot progress. One call per chunk is not a universal total and retry is not a guarantee of complete extraction.
Recall defaults max_tokens to 4096 and exposes separate chunk/source-fact allowances. prefer_observations defaults false; a single number is not automatically a cap on every included payload.
Retrieval result structure represents semantic, BM25, graph and temporal lanes, with graph retrieval delegated to the selected store.

engine_checks.name: Graphiti standalone
engine_checks.scope: Listed functions/ranges only. Not all 57 survey rows or benchmark scores certified.

checks.claim: Single-episode extraction and bulk extraction are different entry points. Bulk combined extraction defaults true; a universal two-call extraction claim is incorrect.
With no candidate edges, the resolver skips dedupe and runs timestamp/optional attribute work; verbatim matching text plus endpoints can reuse an edge and add episode provenance.

gap_checks.title: Neighbour-aware extraction with explicit supersede
gap_checks.codex_finding: Window job passes content/participants/turn_count, not a known-facts set. Ordering is per pipeline worker; cross-process ordering is not established.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Window summary section carried on each fact
gap_checks.codex_finding: Episode summary is requested but deposit uses title+narrative; facts-only modes do not request it.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Durable window queue (retry-safe derivation)
gap_checks.codex_finding: Window jobs/pending edges are process-local. Raw durability depends on configured storage/event-log mode; avoid “always durable” for in-memory deployments.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Integer aliases instead of ids in prompts
gap_checks.codex_finding: Citations use line numbers; invalid indices are filtered. This does not verify the universal claim that no other prompt exposes a record ID.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Local transcript compression before call 1
gap_checks.codex_finding: Window transcript is sent as content; optional pre-compression is not in the inspected job. Mean token counts are not remeasured.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Call 2 content: session summary, stitched episode, profile operations
gap_checks.codex_finding: Default session-close implementation emits a marker and returns stub unless a handler is supplied.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Capped, typed profile card
gap_checks.codex_finding: A per-subject card with a token allowance already exists; “no card or caps” is too broad. Separate it from the proposed persistent typed card.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Episode narratives as a retrieval unit
gap_checks.codex_finding: Episode deposit is implemented in the optional window path. A dedicated retrieval-leg absence was not proven across all extensions.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Value histories and observations with consolidation
gap_checks.codex_finding: Semantic merge retains corroboration and modifies salience. The proposed consolidated observation layer is not proved by those hooks.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Background triggers by volume and idleness
gap_checks.codex_finding: Manual sleep and scheduler invoke cycles through separate paths; no common lock was found in those paths. Overlap was not reproduced.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Standing answers (mental models)
gap_checks.codex_finding: No standing-answer/mental-model implementation found in src/memspine search. An absence search is weaker than a full extension audit.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Reinforcement count as a salience signal
gap_checks.codex_finding: Semantic merge adds importance 0.1 and utility 0.05. This is existing reinforcement; optimal ranking weights are unmeasured.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Hard context budget with block shares
gap_checks.codex_finding: Actual assembly stops early and permits a first oversize item. This is the current documented contract, not a failing existing test; hard-cap design needs a contract change.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Rerank whole neighbour windows
gap_checks.codex_finding: rerank_context adds neighbours before the reranker; blanket “missing contextual rerank” is false.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Temporal window from relative phrases
gap_checks.codex_finding: Relative retrieval uses active_as_of() when provided, otherwise read clock. It is not exclusively read-clock anchored.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Entity boost with an anti-hub penalty
gap_checks.codex_finding: entity_leg ranks name matches without frequency damping; entity_expand_leg has max_share damping.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Evidence lifting and one score across layers
gap_checks.codex_finding: facts_to_sources lifts atomic_fact-tagged records to live parents with same score and dedup. It does not lift every derived type.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Two read tiers with a caller-chosen level
gap_checks.codex_finding: Read-time chain/ledger and agentic modes are configuration choices. A new per-call tier design remains a proposal.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Prompt-cache-friendly calls
gap_checks.codex_finding: Window prompt has a static system template plus dynamic content. Prefix-cache speed benefit was not measured here.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Per-layer cost ledger
gap_checks.codex_finding: Window counters exist; comprehensive per-layer cost/failure accounting is a larger proposal.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Incremental re-ingest of edited documents
gap_checks.codex_finding: Ingest reparses/rechunks the file but skips unchanged chunk writes by path/fingerprint. Needed: changed-chunk derivation plus stale-chunk retirement.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Implicit feedback from conversation
gap_checks.codex_finding: Explicit like/dislike/note API exists. No implicit conversation-feedback extractor was found in the inspected interface.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Per-observer views (theory of mind)
gap_checks.codex_finding: Subject-aware views/cards exist; they are not a complete per-observer belief store. Not every turn is guaranteed these tags in every configuration.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: LLM decider on every read
gap_checks.codex_finding: Optional agentic/read-time components exist; one screen cannot establish a universal ban on decider reads.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Model-written skills and lessons
gap_checks.codex_finding: Skills and successful plans have staged promotion APIs. Keep policy about model-authored lessons separate from capability.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Human-editable Markdown as the source of truth
gap_checks.codex_finding: Rebuild replays projections from event storage. Human-editable Markdown as source of truth is a policy choice, not a proven disadvantage in all products.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Overwrite or delete on update
gap_checks.codex_finding: Graph writes route through semantic supersession machinery, but key short-circuits can bypass it. Do not certify universal history correctness.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Hosted or closed extraction
gap_checks.codex_finding: Engine configuration supports OpenAI/Bedrock/Vertex/Azure and local backends. Local-only evaluation is a project policy, not engine-only capability.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Foresight predictions
gap_checks.codex_finding: auto_watch hook exists for mined plans; this is distinct from proving correctness of future-event predictions.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: KV-cache (activation) memory
gap_checks.codex_finding: No KV-activation memory implementation found in src/memspine search. This does not rule out provider-side inference caching.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Multimodal ingest
gap_checks.codex_finding: Asset precompute and cached evidence tooling exist. Installed model availability was not verified and no vision calls were made.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Same-language rule in every write prompt
gap_checks.codex_finding: Window prompt has no same-language rule; defaults search found no explicit same/original-language instruction. Quality effect remains untested.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Mode and source fields on each fact (denials, who asserted it)
gap_checks.codex_finding: Window prompt conveys plans/wishes in prose; speaker/subject schema fields are not consumed by the fact deposit, though speaker tags can be inherited from parents.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Length bound per fact
gap_checks.codex_finding: Window prompt specifies episode lengths, no word limit on fact value. A global hard word cap is not justified by code.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Diagnostic repair re-ask for a failed section
gap_checks.codex_finding: Fact/edge validators independently drop malformed items; diagnostic repair requires additional orchestration. Successful existing tests do not establish repair quality.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Gold-lint screens single-word tokens
gap_checks.codex_finding: Gold lint includes harness files and known single-token speaker names. Its automatic answer harvesting requires multiword capitalised answers and its prompt glob omits partials.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Coarse dates as full spans
gap_checks.codex_finding: Year and month parse to first day; probes show 2023→Jan 1 and 2023-05→May 1. Precision is lost in the returned datetime.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Importance label at write time
gap_checks.codex_finding: Confidence exists in prompt, but fact deposit ignores it. A new importance label and its usefulness have not been validated.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Online graph call: one short item list per batch of turns
gap_checks.codex_finding: Existing window path is not the proposed unified schema. Duplicate representation is possible, not guaranteed for every relation. Prompt speed/token figures remain unverified measurements.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Graph key identity (kind, occurrence, archived states)
gap_checks.codex_finding: Function probes reproduce kind and same-day occurrence collisions. End-to-end migration and state-return behaviour still need dedicated fixtures.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.

gap_checks.title: Evaluation gate hardening
gap_checks.codex_finding: Missing blind datasets are skipped before verdict; positive available datasets can suffice. This is an evaluation gate defect, separate from model quality.
gap_checks.solution_status: Proposal; improvement not established by source inspection.
